In Round Robin scheduling, what happens to a process if it is not completed after using its time quantum?

mcq.q: What condition determines process selection in non-preemptive priority scheduling ?

options.C: Lowest priority value among arrived processes

mcq.q: What is the initial condition for processes being enqueued in Round Robin scheduling?

options.A: All processes are enqueued at time 1
options.B: Only those with priority > 0 are added

mcq.q: In preemptive priority scheduling , when is a running process interrupted?

options.A: When another process arrives with equal priority
options.B: When another process arrives with lower priority
options.C: When another process arrives with higher priority

mcq.answer_text: When another process arrives with higher priority
